sculpt_easel_painter.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_easel_painter.notes: The painter's field easel (gameplay/errands-props.js makeEasel): bevelled legs, ledge, clamp; a canvas with a moor landscape painted in vertex colour; a paint box with pots, a jar of brushes and a palette at its foot. Faces +Z, origin on the ground; legs 1.65 m. LOD tris 3780 / 2004 / 204. Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, written once).
